# OWELL

> Professional-grade medical supplies, PPE, and janitorial products for healthcare facilities, government agencies, and commercial institutions since 2016.

OWELL specializes in FDA-registered medical exam gloves, diabetes testing supplies (lancets, lancing devices), sterile alcohol prep pads, and commercial janitorial products. The company focuses on bulk procurement and institutional sales with comprehensive B2B solutions including pallet pricing and government contract fulfillment.

## Key Topics

- FDA-registered medical supplies
- Nitrile exam gloves with fentanyl resistance
- Diabetes testing lancets (twist-top and pressure-activated)
- Sterile alcohol prep pads (gamma sterilization)
- Bulk procurement and pallet ordering
- Institutional and government sales
- Food-grade nitrile gloves (21 CFR 177.2600)
- Latex-free PPE products
- Commercial janitorial supplies
- HACCP-compliant products
- Corporate purchasing programs
- Glucose monitoring supplies
- Made in USA products
